note.message: user app cannot be made on web with home /home/bob: it exists already (a directory, 0750 bob:bob), and useradd would make it the home of app as it is (it only warns), without making it app's: app would share another's files, and Mamela would write its SSH keys into another's ~/.ssh
note.hint: declare another home for app, or remove or move /home/bob by hand if nothing needs it; Mamela never takes over a directory that is there
